2643: pub open spec fn page_organization_pages_match_data(
2644:     page_data: PageData,
2645:     pla: PageLocalAccess,
2646:     psa: PageSharedAccess,
2647:     page_id: PageId,
2648:     popped: Popped) -> bool
2649: {
2650:     psa.points_to.is_init() && (
2651:     match (*pla.count.value(), *pla.inner.value(), *pla.prev.value(), *pla.next.value()) {
2652:         (count, inner, prev, next) => {
2653:             &&& (match page_data.count {
2654:                 None => true,
2655:                 Some(c) => count as int == c
2656:             })
2657:             &&& (match page_data.full {
2658:                 None => true,
2659:                 Some(b) => inner.in_full() == b,
2660:             })
2661:             &&& (match page_data.offset {
2662:                 None => true,
2663:                 Some(o) => psa.points_to.value().offset as int ==
2664:                             o * SIZEOF_PAGE_HEADER
2665:             })
2666:             &&& (match page_data.dlist_entry {
2667:                 None => true,
2668:                 Some(page_queue_data) => {
2669:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(prev, page_queue_data.prev)
2670:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(next, page_queue_data.next)
2671:                 }
2672:             })
2673:             &&& (match page_data.page_header_kind {
2674:                 None => {
2675:                     (page_id.idx == 0 ==> {
2676:                       &&& !page_data.is_used
2677:                       &&& (match popped {
2678:                           Popped::SegmentCreating(sid) if sid == page_id.segment_id =>
2679:                               true,
2680:                           _ => inner.xblock_size != 0
2681:                       })
2682:                       &&& (!popped.is_SegmentCreating() ==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
2683:                     })
2684:                     && (page_id.idx != 0 ==> page_data.offset == Some(0nat) ==> (
2685:                         (!(popped.is_Ready() && popped.get_Ready_0() == page_id) &&
2686:                             !(popped.is_VeryUnready() && popped.get_VeryUnready_0() == page_id.segment_id && popped.get_VeryUnready_1() == page_id.idx))
2687:                           ==>
2688:                         (page_data.is_used <==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
2689:                     ))
2690:                 }
2691:                 Some(PageHeaderKind::Normal(_, bsize)) => {
2692:                     &&& page_id.idx != 0
2693:                     &&& page_data.is_used
2694:                     &&& inner.xblock_size != 0
2695:                     &&& inner.xblock_size == bsize
2696:                     &&& page_data.is_used
2697:                     &&& page_data.offset == Some(0nat)
2698:                 }
2699:             })
2700:         }
2701:     })
2702: }

8215:     pub closed spec fn ec_of_popped(p: Popped, segment_id: SegmentId) -> int {
8216:         match p {
8217:             Popped::No => 0,
8218:             Popped::Ready(p, b) => if p.segment_id == segment_id && b { 1 } else { 0 },
8219:             Popped::Used(p, b) => if p.segment_id == segment_id {
8220:                 if b { 0 } else { -1 }
8221:               } else { 0 }
8222:             Popped::SegmentCreating(_) => 0,
8223:             Popped::VeryUnready(sid, _, _, b) => if segment_id == sid && b { 1 } else { 0 },
8224:             Popped::SegmentFreeing(_, _) => 0,
8225:             Popped::ExtraCount(sid) => if segment_id == sid { 1 } else { 0 },

            Popped::Used(p, b) => if p.segment_id == segment_id {

pub open spec fn is_header(pd: PageData) -> bool {
    pd.offset == Some(0nat)
}

pub open spec fn is_unused_header(pd: PageData) -> bool {
    pd.offset == Some(0nat) && !pd.is_used
}

pub open spec fn is_used_header(pd: PageData) -> bool {
    pd.offset == Some(0nat) && pd.is_used
}

pub open spec fn get_next(ll: Seq<PageId>, j: int) -> Option<PageId> {
    if j == ll.len() - 1 {
        None
    } else {
        Some(ll[j + 1])
    }
}

pub open spec fn get_prev(ll: Seq<PageId>, j: int) -> Option<PageId> {
    if j == 0 {
        None
    } else {
        Some(ll[j - 1])
    }
}

pub open spec fn valid_ll_i(pages: Map<PageId, PageData>, ll: Seq<PageId>, j: int) -> bool {
    0 <= j < ll.len()
      && pages.dom().contains(ll[j])
      && pages[ll[j]].dlist_entry.is_some()
      && pages[ll[j]].dlist_entry.unwrap().prev == get_prev(ll, j)
      && pages[ll[j]].dlist_entry.unwrap().next == get_next(ll, j)
}

pub open spec fn valid_ll(pages: Map<PageId, PageData>, header: DlistHeader, ll: Seq<PageId>) -> bool {
    &&& (match header.first {
        Some(first_id) => ll.len() != 0 && ll[0] == first_id,
        None => ll.len() == 0,
    })
    &&& (match header.last {
        Some(last_id) => ll.len() != 0 && ll[ll.len() - 1] == last_id,
        None => ll.len() == 0,
    })

pub open spec fn mem_chunk_good1(
    mem: MemChunk,
    segment_id: SegmentId,
    commit_bytes: Set<int>,
    decommit_bytes: Set<int>,
    pages_range_total: Set<int>,
    pages_used_total: Set<int>,
) -> bool {
    &&& mem.wf()
    &&& mem.os_exact_range(segment_start(segment_id), SEGMENT_SIZE as int)
    &&& mem.points_to.provenance() == segment_id.provenance

    &&& commit_bytes.subset_of(mem.os_rw_bytes())

    &&& decommit_bytes <= commit_bytes
    &&& segment_info_range(segment_id) <= commit_bytes - decommit_bytes
    &&& pages_used_total <= commit_bytes - decommit_bytes

    &&& mem.os_rw_bytes() <=
          mem.points_to.dom()
            + segment_info_range(segment_id)
            + pages_range_total
}
